_comment: Capture states. Each state describes a way to take an additional screenshot of the same route, beyond the default render. The harness runs `setup_steps` (a list of Playwright actions described as JSON) before capture for each state. Most states require manual setup hooks per-product — they're documented here so the agent knows what to look for during analysis.

default.description: The page as it loads, no user interaction. Always captured.

hover-primary.description: Primary action button hovered. Tests hover affordance.

focus-first-input.description: First form input focused. Tests focus indicator visibility (WCAG SC 2.4.7).

form-error.description: Form submitted with invalid data, errors rendered. Requires per-product setup.

loading.description: Async action in flight. Spinner / skeleton visible. Requires per-product setup.

empty.description: List / table / dashboard with zero results. Requires test data or per-product setup.

dark.description: Dark color scheme via prefers-color-scheme: dark.

high-contrast.description: Forced-colors / high contrast mode (Windows). Tests SC 1.4.11 fallbacks.

reduced-motion.description: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. Animations should be suppressed.

zoom-200.description: Browser zoom at 200%. Tests SC 1.4.4 Resize Text.
